is_anopheles.evidence: The study sequenced the genomes of 765 specimens of Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles coluzzii (Page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports on Vgsc L995F (L1014F), L995S (L1014S), and N1570Y (N1575Y) (Page 7, Figure 4).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Allele frequencies for L995F and L995S are provided for several countries (Guinea 100%; Burkina Faso 93%; Cameroon 53%; Gabon 36%; Angola 86%; Cameroon 15%; Gabon 65%; Uganda 100%; Kenya 76%) on page 7, and sample sizes for each population are provided in the table in Extended Data Figure 1.

african_field_population.evidence: The study analyzed 765 wild-caught specimens collected from 15 locations across 8 African countries: Angola, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Gabon, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Kenya, and Uganda (Page 3, Extended Data Figure 1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting the first phase of the Ag1000G project.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is tied to 15 specific sampling sites, such as Koraboh, Koundara, Antula, Bana, Sourukoudinga, Pala, Gado-Badzere, Zembe-Borongo, Daiguene, Mayos, Libreville, Luanda, Tororo, Kilifi-Mbogolo, and Kilifi-Junju (Extended Data Figure 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collection years are provided for each site (e.g., 2012, 2009, 2000) in Extended Data Figure 1.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is the primary publication for Phase 1 of the Ag1000G project (Page 3).

supplement.evidence: Frequencies and sample sizes required for extraction are present in the main text and Extended Data Figure 1.

assessment.summary: This is the primary publication for Phase 1 of the Ag1000G project, reporting whole-genome sequencing of 765 wild-caught Anopheles gambiae and An. coluzzii from 15 locations across 8 African countries. The study reports frequencies for the insecticide-resistance markers Vgsc L995F, L995S, and N1570Y.
